CodeHive Rivalry Night is a community-driven coding event where developers compete in real-time 1v1 coding battles. Forget solving problems alone. Challenge other developers, test your approach, and experience competitive coding in a more interactive way. What to Expect Real-time 1v1 DSA coding duels. Multiple rounds featuring coding challenges. Compete against fellow developers. Test your problem-solving speed and accuracy. Meet and connect with other coding enthusiasts. Event Details Date: Saturday, 28 November 2026 Start Time: 8:00 PM IST Check-in: 7:45 PM IST Mode: Online Platform: CodeHive Participation: Individual Registration Fee: Free How to Participate Register for the event on Unstop. Visit https://www.thecodehive.tech/ and create your CodeHive account. Sign in before the event. Check in by 7:45 PM IST. Join the competition and take on your opponents! Important: Unstop registration alone does not complete your participation. Make sure you have a CodeHive account before the event. Who Can Participate? Anyone interested in DSA, competitive programming, coding challenges, or improving their problem-solving skills. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced programmer, you're welcome! Don't Just Practise. Compete. Bring your skills, challenge your limits, and find out how you perform against other developers. See you on CodeHive!

raw.details:
CodeHive Rivalry Night #2 – Real-Time DSA Coding Battles

Think you can solve DSA problems under pressure? Put your problem-solving skills to the test!

CodeHive Rivalry Night is a community-driven coding event where developers compete in real-time 1v1 coding battles.

Forget solving problems alone. Challenge other developers, test your approach, and experience competitive coding in a more interactive way.

What to Expect

  • Real-time 1v1 DSA coding duels.

  • Multiple rounds featuring coding challenges.

  • Compete against fellow developers.

  • Test your problem-solving speed and accuracy.

  • Meet and connect with other coding enthusiasts.

Event Details

  • Date: Saturday, 28 November 2026

  • Start Time: 8:00 PM IST

  • Check-in: 7:45 PM IST

  • Mode: Online

  • Platform: CodeHive

  • Participation: Individual

  • Registration Fee: Free

How to Participate

  • Register for the event on Unstop.

  • Visit https://www.thecodehive.tech/ and create your CodeHive account.

  • Sign in before the event.

  • Check in by 7:45 PM IST.

  • Join the competition and take on your opponents!

Important: Unstop registration alone does not complete your participation. Make sure you have a CodeHive account before the event.

Who Can Participate?

Anyone interested in DSA, competitive programming, coding challenges, or improving their problem-solving skills.

Whether you're a beginner or an experienced programmer, you're welcome!

Don't Just Practise. Compete.

Bring your skills, challenge your limits, and find out how you perform against other developers.

See you on CodeHive!
